status: Exploratory range characterization, frozen before these new results; previous positive results already known
queries: 1000 uniformly sampled from each original 3000-query task; fixed seed20261106; same queries in every configuration; archived PCA unchanged

outputs: any-switch counts and margins per cell, union of switches across both methods/seeds as a sampled reference set (not exhaustive groundtruth), precision within this sampled union at fixed10% review budget compared to entropy/confidence using derivatives only, no query labels used to find switches
selective_extension: Reuse all previous held-out coverage curves50-100%; subgroup Control vsPF for lung andNormal/Tumor liver using metadata; no refitting or changing model. Bootstrap paired donors conditional on fixed models; report all settings, including negatives.
claim_scope: Range within existing datasets and fixed RNA geometry. No new cohort, new wall-time speedup, generic classifier, global certified robustness or guaranteed biological truth claim. Existing manuscript not overwritten by exploratory range screening.
